Hero.headline: Practice the interview before it counts.
Hero.description: Speculo runs a real interview with you — asks the questions, listens to your answers, and scores you the way a real interviewer would.
Hero.demoQuestion: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
Hero.demoAnswer: I proposed we each list our concerns, then found where they overlapped...
Hero.demoFeedback: Clear example with a concrete resolution. Could go deeper on the outcome.

RolesCarousel.headline: Built for the role you're interviewing for.
RolesCarousel.backendBody: APIs, databases, auth, and system reliability.
RolesCarousel.fullstackBody: End-to-end ownership, from schema to UI.

WhySpeculo.heading: Why Speculo?
WhySpeculo.feature1Description: Speculo generates role-specific interview questions and adapts follow-ups based on your answers, just like a real interviewer would.
WhySpeculo.feature2Title: Built for the role you're targeting
WhySpeculo.feature2Description: Practice sessions are tailored to your exact stack and job title, not generic interview questions.
WhySpeculo.feature3Description: Every session is scored and logged, so you can see exactly where you're improving before the real interview.

TakeAction.description: Speculo let you feel the sensation of a real interview with an expertise senior developer, who will ask you questions and give you feedback on your answers.

Footer.quote: Every question deserves a real answer — and every answer deserves honest feedback. That's the whole point of practicing before it counts.
